core_obligations: Transport the comparison functor to the affine-etale sites
Prove full faithfulness via the detection subcategory
Prove essential surjectivity through the derived tensor vanishing
difficulty_reason: Comparison of the unbounded derived category of quasi-coherent sheaves on an algebraic stack with the affine-etale site of its small etale topos: builds G from the functor of lemma-compare, proves full faithfulness through the detection subcategory Q_X, and essential surjectivity by the derived tensor identity RGamma(x_i, M) = RGamma(x_i', M) (x)_{O(x_i')}^L O(x_i) = 0 forcing M = 0; every step is carried out in the span. Retained author proof at lines 5010-5128.
